subject: feat(evals): separate objective and semantic result axes
diff_check: clean change.diff is byte-identical to git diff of the parent and commit (abbrev 8); patch -p1 of both change.diff files onto an archive of the parent reproduces the variant trees (checked)

clean.description: The change as committed. No defect is planted.

seeded.description: One of two parallel sites that the commit updated is reverted. In buildSemanticPrompt's multi-turn (rpc-scripted) branch, the grader's evidence sets objective_checks_passed to true, a constant, instead of the objective result. The single-run branch keeps the commit's objective.objective_pass.
seeded.rule_quoted: requirements.md item 7: "The grader's evidence reports the objective axis as it stands: objective_checks_passed is true exactly when the run's objective checks passed, for every kind of run the grader can receive."

proof.method: convention: quote the rule and the seeded line, plus a direct call showing the wrong value, and show that no existing test notices
proof.command: EXPORT=<export root> node --test <proof_test_file>   (once with the clean export, once with the seeded export)
proof.clean_result: 2 tests, 2 pass, 0 fail (failed objective run, multi-turn: objective_checks_passed false; passing run: true)
proof.seeded_result: 2 tests, 1 pass, 1 fail: the failed-objective multi-turn run reports objective_checks_passed true (expected false)

no_existing_test_detects_it.command: find .skill-eval/evaluate-skill/tests -name '*.test.mjs' | sort | xargs node --test   (run in the clean export and in the seeded export, per-test ok/not ok lines compared)
no_existing_test_detects_it.seeded_result: 163 tests, 149 pass, 14 fail; per-test outcomes identical
no_existing_test_detects_it.note: The 14 failures are the same in both trees. They are git-backed tests ("Unable to inspect git subject resource ...: not a git repository") that fail in an archive export without .git. They are not part of the proof.

unsure: The seed is an absence: in the seeded change.diff, the multi-turn hunk has no change, because the seeded line equals the parent's line. A reviewer has to notice that the file still says true at line 104 after the commit updated line 126.
The rule in item 7 is general (every kind of run). The grader's evidence is a convention rule under this protocol; it is not a test-visible contract, so the class depends on reading the requirement.

verification.md claims only the coordinator and semantic test files (16 pass). The v3-phase1 report claims 163 evaluator tests passed; in an archive export 14 of those fail for lack of git history, so that claim was not reproduced here.
rerun: node --test .skill-eval/evaluate-skill/tests/coordinator.test.mjs .skill-eval/evaluate-skill/tests/semantic.test.mjs : 16/16 pass on clean and on seeded
find .skill-eval/evaluate-skill/tests -name '*.test.mjs' | sort | xargs node --test : 163 tests, 149 pass, 14 fail on both; per-test outcomes identical
